scope_note: Declarative contract only. No OCR engine, model, GPU, cloud call or deployment is used or authorized by this file.

pairing_rule.requirement: every engine must process the identical hash; results are joined per hash and never per filename or per locale aggregate
reject_if: hash missing from the sealed selection manifest
document used in development or validation
engine output produced from a resized, re-cropped or re-encoded image

dataset_contract.precondition: status == ready and selected_document_count matches the planned splits
dataset_contract.reference: adjudicated annotation only (two blind annotations + human arbitration); never a pipeline prediction, never a historical reference
dataset_contract.tuning_rule: no engine, threshold, preprocessing or prompt may be tuned on final_test; selection happens on validation only

B.description: RapidOCR with an explicitly pinned compatible language model
B.status: not installed; installation requires separate authorization
B.known_risk: RapidOCR default models are not presumed French/English compatible; language suitability must be demonstrated, not assumed

C.description: proposals from distinct engines kept separate, with abstention instead of confident disagreement
constraints: each proposal keeps its engine, box and confidence
disagreement yields null + review flag, never a majority vote as proof
arithmetic consistency is a warning, never evidence of the printed value
no value may be accepted solely because two correlated engines agree

metrics.definition: proportion of annotated cells whose recognised text matches the reference text after documented normalisation
proportion of accepted cells assigned to the correct column role
proportion of line values attached to the correct line index
strict string equality on line descriptions
token-overlap based substantial match on descriptions
share of accepted values that are correct
share of annotated present fields that are accepted
count of accepted quantity/price/line-amount values that are wrong
share of scorable cells emitted as null
share of annotated lines fully recovered
share of documents with correct line ordering

criteria.threshold: == 0 for quantity, unit price and line amount
>= +5 percentage points versus Tesseract alone on the pre-registered target
no locale loses net numeric accuracy
no regression in the frozen suite
<= 45 s per document within the existing OCR budget

reporting_requirements: separate development, validation and final_test results
state that the 15-document pilot is not a confirmatory statistical proof
report every failure, including engines that were not run

comparison_rules: score A and B on exactly the same hashes and the same adjudicated reference
report A/B/C per metric and per locale, never only as an aggregate
do not accept a value because the arithmetic reconciles
do not let an engine abstain on a cell and count it as a correct refusal without scoring recall
keep development/validation/final_test results separate and disclose any post-hoc change as a new pre-registration
prohibited: installing or executing RapidOCR without explicit authorization
calling Qwen, a GPU service or any cloud API
modifying production code, thresholds or grounding
presenting synthetic labels or historical references as independent ground truth
